description: Read a folder and write a digest of it to DIGEST.md.
goal: Read the folder {{input}}: list it, then read every file in it. Then write DIGEST.md in the current folder, in Markdown: a short paragraph saying what the folder holds and what it is for, then one line per file -- its path and, in a few words, what it contains. Change nothing else, and say the task is done once DIGEST.md is written.
input: The folder to digest, relative to where the task runs.
name: digest-folder
